full_details: Hilary term opened. You walked west with George Bryan and stood under the hammer-beam while a client, charged to have his trouble shortened, said it again at greater length. Walking back by the Strand you said they sell explanations by the sheet, and so do you, with jokes in. The play at two was Two Gentlemen of Verona. You were not cast. From the parlour door you heard them laugh before a line was done. Margery, at the gallery stair, had thirty-three shillings in her box: lawyers, lawyers' men, two aldermen's wives, and a horse-courser. The Rose bill was The Wise Man of West Chester. You did not go.
one_sentence: You stood in Westminster Hall while a man said his grievance longer than the sheet he had paid for, and heard Margery's thirty-three shillings.
title: Heard a long grievance and Margery's thirty-three shillings
